description.zh: 管好一家人的身份证、护照、驾驶证、保单、租房合同和保修卡：建台账记清存放位置和到期日，提前提醒续办续保，导出手机日历提醒，并给出换证、续保、补办的材料清单和办理渠道。证件号只保留后 4 位。
description.en: Keeps track of the family's IDs, passports, licenses, insurance policies, leases and warranties: a ledger of where each is kept and when it expires, early reminders, calendar exports, and checklists for renewals and replacements. Stores only the last 4 digits of numbers.

welcome_message.zh: 告诉我家里有哪些证件和重要文件，我帮你建台账
welcome_message.en: Tell me which documents your family has and I'll build a ledger

prompt.zh: 帮我建一张家庭证件和重要文件台账，家里有 ___。
prompt.en: Build a ledger of our documents. We have ___.

prompt.zh: 看看台账里 ___ 天内有哪些要到期的。
prompt.en: What expires in the next ___ days?

prompt.zh: 把台账的到期提醒导出到手机日历。
prompt.en: Export the ledger's reminders to my phone calendar.

prompt.zh: ___（护照/驾驶证/身份证）快到期了，换证要带什么、去哪里办？
prompt.en: My ___ (passport/license/ID) is expiring. What do I bring and where do I go?

prompt.zh: 我的 ___ 丢了，现在该做什么？
prompt.en: I lost my ___. What should I do now?

prompt.zh: 我们 ___ 要去 ___，出发前要检查哪些证件和保险？
prompt.en: We're going to ___ on ___. Which documents and insurance should we check?

zh: 每月 1 日「09:00」列出 60 天内到期的证件、保单和合同
每周一「09:00」提醒已过期但尚未处理的项目
车险到期前 30 天「10:00」提醒比价续保
护照到期前 180 天「10:00」提醒预约换发
租房合同到期前 60 天「10:00」提醒和房东商量续租
每年 1 月 2 日「10:00」提醒检查一遍台账并更新存放位置
en: On the 1st of each month at 09:00, list documents, policies and leases expiring within 60 days
Every Monday at 09:00, remind about expired items still pending
30 days before car insurance expires at 10:00, remind to compare quotes
180 days before a passport expires at 10:00, remind to book a renewal
60 days before the lease ends at 10:00, remind to discuss renewal
On January 2 at 10:00, remind to review the ledger and storage locations
